parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking instance.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the DTS instance is located. For more information, see [List of Supported Regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

*   **Forward**
*   **Reverse**

> 
*   Default value: **Forward**.
*   You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to reset the reverse synchronization task only when the topology is two-way synchronization.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts reset-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-aekzn4iqlbsm7hy --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ResetDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzn4iqlbsm7hy' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
